notes.title: Update - Alpha 2.2
notes.notes:
1. Store
  - Items sold in stores are updated daily.
  - Quantity restrictions have been added to items sold in stores.
  - The basic collection of trees, branches, dirt and coal is sold in stores.

2. Items
  - The price of the item is specified in the shop purchase price and when the user sells
   The transaction window is displayed at a reduced price.
  - Kulture has been added to potions and certain items.
  - Price of all items and information such as cool time has been corrected.
    (This information will be updated several times in order to adjust the balance.)

2. Character
  - The character's walking motion has been modified.
  - Short jump, long jump more clearly separated. To jump a long distance
   You can jump more distances by moving + jump, dash + jump, and more.
  - If you hit the ceiling during a jump, do not fall immediately,
    I have. (* Watch: I will have additional fix after checking user feedback)

3. Monster
  - Fixed a problem that some monsters can not fall into the water.
  - The speed of automatic cannon is randomly set.
  - Fixed the problem of some monsters dying and flying.

4. Dungeon
  - A new room pattern has been added to the dungeon.
  - Fixed an issue where background objects are not displayed correctly on some maps.
 
5. Other
  - Fixed a problem that the shield's durability does not wear out.
  - The rate of wood has increased.
  - A recipe has been added to the inventory combination.
    (Wood carvings can be used like wood.)

notes.title: Update - Alpha 2.1.0
notes.notes:
1. Item
  - A new item [Scroll Of Destruction Weapon] has been created.
    * Weapon Destruction Order will destroy the selected weapon.
       and make an [Enchant Stone]

  - A new item [Scroll Of Destruction Armor] has been created.
    * Armor Destruction Order will destroy the selected armor.
       and make an [Enchant Stone]

 - A new item [Enchant Stone] has been created.
    * Combine with weapons to increase experience or level.

  - A new item [Scroll of enchant accessories] has been created.
    * Scroll of enchant accessories is reset the accessories options

  - [Scroll of enchant Weapon] increases your weapon by +1 level
    when you succeed.

  - [Scroll of enchant Armor] increases your armor by +1 level
    when you succeed.




2. The combination (bench)
  -  The recipe for the existing [Scroll of enchant Weapon] has been
     modified to a [Scroll Of Destruction Weapon] 
    * Paper + Blood Feather + Weapon = [Scroll Of Destruction Weapon]

  -  The recipe for the existing [Scroll of enchant Armor] has been
     modified to a [Scroll Of Destruction Armor] 
    * Paper + Blood Feather + Armor = [Scroll Of Destruction Armor]

- The recipe for [Scroll of enchant Weapon] has been fixed.
     * Scroll Of Destruction Weapon + Blooded Feather + 
       Enchant Stone =  [Scroll of enchant Weapon]

- The recipe for [Scroll of enchant Armor] has been fixed.
     * Scroll Of Destruction Armor + Blooded Feather + 
       Enchant Stone =  [Scroll of enchant Armor]

- Combination of [Scroll of enchant Accessories] has been added.
     * Scroll Of Destruction Weapon +  Scroll Of Destruction Armor + 
      Accessories =  [Scroll of enchant Accessories]



3. Quest
  - The rewards of some quests have changed.

notes.title: Update - Alpha 1.35.1 - 3
notes.notes:
1. Battle
  - Some combat formulas have been modified.
     (The battle formula will be modified a few more times after additional testing.)
  - Fixed an issue where boss monsters became abnormally strong.
  - When the boss monster dies, it will drop more gold.
  - Ability values ​of some equipment have been modified.
    (Some equipment may be modified a few more times after additional testing.)
  - Add Miss Effect when a monster attack fail.

2. Store
  - Tools like basic shovels, axes, and pickaxes are sold by weapon
    merchants, not tool traders.
  - The tool merchant sells more potions and setup items.
  - Resolved the problem that the discount rate of the technology of
     transactions was not applied.

3. Item
  - Price of some items has been revised.
  - Some items have been modified.

4. UI
  - Some fonts in the character selection window have been modified.
  - Some fonts in the character creation window have been modified.
  - You can select the real-time storage menu in the options window.
  - In the options window, you can choose whether to look at the
    mouse when attacking.
  - You can set the item slot double click recognition time.
  - You can set the wait time for item tooltip output.
  - Fixed the problem that Wis is displayed in the resistance value area
     in the status window.

notes.title: Update - Alpha 1.35
notes.notes:
1. Battle
  - Fixed monster Reinforcement formula when moving
     between dungeon stage.
  - Fixed monster attack damage formula.  
  - Fixed monster element damage formula.
  - Fixed shield's shielding formula
  - The abrasive repair weapon's durability.

2. Combination system
- Basic Combination Help button has been added at bench windows.
- A tooltip with an item name has been added to the help window.
- Combine equipment and ore in combination repair the equipment durability. 
  (The both of materials should be the same. )

3. Quest
- Various items will be paid for the daily quests.
- Reward EXP of the daily quest is applied flexibly according to level.

4. Town
- Monsters drop and miscellaneous can be sold to the store.
- The guards do not randomly tip but talk to each tip in turn.
- Guards dialog have been added & corrected.

5. Miner
- No more miner will be paid the miner's ore until a player gets it.
- Miner expertise has been modified with the chance of obtaining additional ore.
- Increases the level of miner's ore to increase the probability of batter ore.

6. System
- No more support for real-time save.
- As the item storage method is changed, it takes more time to load.
- If the item locker weighs more than, the heaviest item returned to the inventory.
- The effect of changing day and night has been modified to slow.

7. Bug
- Fixed a problem where a shielded attack would cause damage.
- Fixed the problem some daily quest.

notes.title: Update - Alpha 1.28
notes.notes:
Resolved Issues
  - Fixed the problem of not recognizing immediately when
    acquiring quest items.
  - Fixed the problem that specific item does not come into inventory.

1. Tutorial

    added to the description of the jump.

    when collecting resources.
  - Fixed a hammer that can be used to collect installed items in the tutorial.
  - We have added rope so that you can use the rope in the section
    where the wooden box is installed.

2. Quest

  - Monsters that have not yet been revealed in Daily Quests no longer appear.

3. NPC

    useful tips for your game.
